eps.o: With the help of unexpected allies, Ronin faces off against a twisted Jedi out for revenge.
A princess-turned-rebel protects a child from the might of the Empire.

eps.t: The Ninth Jedi: Child of Hope
eps.o: Adrift in space and pursued by Jedi Hunters, Kara encounters a ship tended by a mysterious droid.
A bounty hunter's job for a shady industrialist has unexpected consequences for her and her droid.
A sheltered orphan teams up with a streetwise kid to rescue his droid and find a lost treasure.
While helping refugees escape disaster, an incognito F is forced to confront the ghosts of her past.
Desperate for a quick payday, a smuggler takes a job to rescue a fugitive from the Empire.
Blinded in battle, a Jedi padawan must undergo a series of spiritual trials to resist the Dark Side.
On the cusp of defeat, a psychedelic battle plays out in the haunted psyche of an Imperial trooper.
